comment:
* Represents a GLSL shader program. * *

After constructing a program, keep a reference for its lifetime and call {@link #delete()} * (or release the current GL context) when it's no longer needed.

variables.name: programId
variables.comment: The identifier of a compiled and linked GLSL shader program.

methods.name: public void use()
methods.comment:
* Uses the program. * *

Call this in the rendering loop to switch between different programs.

methods.name: public void delete()
methods.comment: Deletes the program. Deleted programs cannot be used again.

methods.name: public int getAttributeArrayLocationAndEnable(String attributeName)
methods.comment:
* Returns the location of an {@link Attribute}, which has been enabled as a vertex attribute
     * array.

methods.name: private int getAttributeLocation(String attributeName)
methods.comment: Returns the location of an {@link Attribute}.

methods.name: public int getUniformLocation(String uniformName)
methods.comment: Returns the location of a {@link Uniform}.

methods.name: public void setBufferAttribute(String name, float[] values, int size)
methods.comment: Sets a float buffer type attribute.

methods.name: public void setSamplerTexIdUniform(String name, int texId, int unit)
methods.comment: Sets a texture sampler type uniform.

methods.name: public void setFloatUniform(String name, float value)
public void setFloatsUniform(String name, float[] value)
methods.comment: Sets a float array type uniform.

methods.name: public void bindAttributesAndUniforms()
methods.comment: Binds all attributes and uniforms in the program.
